reason: My guests find me on Instagram and Google Maps, I already post the specials there for free. I raised prices twice this year, I'm not adding 25 € a month for a website nobody opens.
objection: It updates a website, but my people look at Instagram and Google Maps. If it doesn't push the specials and hours there too, it's just one more place to keep updated.
would_change_my_mind: If one message also updated my Google Maps hours and menu and posted the special to Instagram, not just the website.
